newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares close lower, investors sidelined.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares close lower, investors sidelined.

text.p: * Market in a lull after last week's rally
Manila shares closed lower for the second straight day as investors remained sidelined after last week's sharp gains, traders said on Tuesday.
The main index shaved off 13.91 points to 3,196.39 points following Monday's 16.16-point slide. Declines outnumbered advances 54 to 45, while 70 issues were unchanged.
"The market needs more fueling in terms of news to further bolster confidence," said broker Gilpatrick Garcia.
"The market seems in a base-building phase" at above 3,100 points, Garcia added.
The current initial public offering of shopping mall developer Ever-Gotesco Resources and Holdings Inc continues to take away investments from the stock market, traders said.
Garcia believes the market could remain in the doldrums on Wednesday although others said there could be positioning ahead of next week's release of second quarter economic growth figures.
Among the index stocks, Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co fell 20 pesos to 1,555 pesos.
